```{r}
## Load packages ----
library(tidyverse)

## Example: read your ATP data (update file name/path as needed) ----
## For W84 .sav use haven if you're in R:
# library(haven)
# atp_w84 <- read_sav("ATP W84.sav")

## 1. Table of important variables by hypothesis ----

hypothesis_table <- tibble::tribble(
  ~Hypothesis, ~HBM_construct, ~Key_variables, ~Why_important,

  "H1: Perceived susceptibility → online vs in-person",
  "Perceived susceptibility",
  "ATTENDCONF; CONGRESTRICT2abc",
  "Strong differences by online vs in-person; directly measure perceived chance of getting/spreading COVID.",

  "H2: Perceived severity → online worship",
  "Perceived severity",
  "COVIDTHREAT",
  "Best direct measure of how serious people think COVID is; large mean differences for online vs not online.",

  "H3: Self-efficacy → online worship",
  "Digital self-efficacy (proxy)",
  "SNSUSE",
  "Social media use is a proxy for digital comfort and confidence using online platforms.",

  "H4: Direct structural facilitators → online worship",
  "Direct structural access",
  "F_ASCWEB; COVIDCONG2; COVIDCONG3",
  "Internet access and whether the congregation streams / limits capacity strongly shape online worship.",

  "H5: Indirect structural barriers → online worship",
  "Indirect structural barriers to in-person",
  "Congregation operating status; requires 6ft distance; requires masks",
  "Closures and strict rules make in-person harder and are strongly related to watching online.",

  "H6: Opposition to restrictions → in-person worship",
  "Opposition to embodied restrictions",
  "CONGRESTRICT2d (singing limits)",
  "Disagreement with limiting/prohibiting singing signals preference for in-person worship.",

  "H7: Cues to action → online worship",
  "Cues / triggers",
  "SERMONISSUEc; CTKNOW1",
  "Hearing sermons about COVID and knowing about contact tracing act as cues that push people toward online options.",

  "H8: Denominational differences (Catholics vs Protestants)",
  "Group moderation (denomination)",
  "Same key variables from H1–H7 plus denomination indicator",
  "Compare effects of susceptibility, severity, structural factors, opposition, and cues between Catholics and Protestants."
)

## Look at the table
hypothesis_table
# knitr::kable(hypothesis_table, caption = "Important variables for each hypothesis")



## 2. Named list of variables for each hypothesis ----
## (You can use this to select variables from atp_w70 or atp_w84)

hvars <- list(
  H1 = c("ATTENDCONF", "CONGRESTRICT2abc"),
  H2 = c("COVIDTHREAT"),
  H3 = c("SNSUSE"),
  H4 = c("F_ASCWEB", "COVIDCONG2", "COVIDCONG3"),
  H5 = c("CONG_OPER_STATUS",    # replace with actual variable name used in your data
         "CONG_REQUIRE_6FT",    # e.g. congregation requires 6ft distance
         "CONG_REQUIRE_MASKS"), # e.g. congregation requires masks
  H6 = c("CONGRESTRICT2d"),
  H7 = c("SERMONISSUEc", "CTKNOW1"),
  H8 = c("DENOM",       # e.g. Catholic vs Protestant indicator
         "ATTENDCONF", "CONGRESTRICT2abc",
         "COVIDTHREAT",
         "F_ASCWEB", "COVIDCONG2", "COVIDCONG3",
         "CONG_OPER_STATUS", "CONG_REQUIRE_6FT", "CONG_REQUIRE_MASKS",
         "CONGRESTRICT2d",
         "SERMONISSUEc", "CTKNOW1")
)
```
